reads.note: Complete independent current registry read: includes/registers28 matrix tests, covering characteristic/determinant, decomposition, solving, kernels and functions. Registration/execution does not credit unread constituent tests or strengthen permissive assertions. Four determinant/LU test families were independently read here; other constituent reads remain pending.

Complete independent archived test read: compares two randomly selected determinant algorithms at dimensions0..5 and determinant multiplicativity at0..4; ignores method success flags and fails only T_FALSE, allowing Unknown. Same implementation or correlated scalar errors can agree. Does not require completion on certified singular inputs.

Complete independent current test read: cross-method comparison only at dimensions0..4 and multiplicativity at0..3, with reduced iteration multiplier. Thus default determinant selection for larger same-number-field matrices is never exercised by this file. Return flags are ignored and Unknown equality passes, explaining why the focused singular/default-LU completeness controls add evidence.

Complete independent archived test read: integer matrices of generated rank, optional rank-preserving random operations, rectangular dimensions0..9, packed LU shape and permuted L*U reconstruction. Only successful decompositions are checked; reconstruction Unknown passes, required trailing zeros do not. Every call uses rank_check=0, so this does not cover nonsingularity early-stop semantics.

Complete independent archived test read: directly tests classical LU on generated integer ranks, with required-True trailing-zero shape and T_FALSE-only reconstruction check. Failed decomposition is accepted; rank_check is always0. Duplicate permutation/check helpers use row-pointer swapping and independent owned L/U matrices.

Complete independent archived test read: direct recursive LU, generated known-rank integer matrices and optional row/column operations; checks rank and packed factor reconstruction only on success. All calls use rank_check=0, so early singularity reporting through nonsingular_lu is not qualified. Reconstruction Unknown passes; trailing zeros require proof.

Complete independent current test read: same generated-rank/packed-LU contract, with guarded shared helper definitions and strided payload permutation rather than row pointers. Every call rank_check=0; only success is inspected, reconstruction Unknown passes, trailing zero shape requires True. The new rank_check=1 singular corpus is distinct evidence.

Complete independent current test read: direct classical LU on generated integer matrices with rank_check=0; guarded shared helpers copy raw strided payloads for permutation and clear only owned reconstructed matrices. Complete independent current test read: direct recursive LU with integer generated ranks and rank_check=0. Guards prevent helper redefinition in combined runner; valid strided permutation tested, not arbitrary overlapping windows or invalid indices.

Complete independent archived read: Dense matrix owner/window API, scalar scaling, exact/partial determinant and solve signatures. No blind Rust storage replacement: Hyper fixed matrices are already contiguous and dynamic solver rows support cheap swaps.

status: Matrix source/capability checkpoint and completed monic downstream; monic live retention recorded separately. Full ecosystem incomplete.
limits: Native determinant oracle covers finite diagonal, row-swapped and repeated-row matrices; no general matrix or archived runtime qualification. Generic same-scalar oracles are not independent scalar backends. Hyper determinant construction and decidable equality are separate capabilities. Standalone Faddeev/Berkowitz probes are not production algorithms or matched benchmarks. Berkowitz gains eight comparisons but loses two: not selected as a direct replacement; alternate scheduling remains open. Nine pre-existing Hypercurve ignored tests remain unrun.
